title: The Vatican's AI-Assisted Encyclical: A Builder's Debrief
caption: Everyone's talking about the Vatican's new encyclical. Almost nobody noticed the Anthropic byline. Pope Leo XIV's 'Magnifica humanitas' is set to publish May 25, a significant event in its own right. But for us builders, the real story isn't the content itself, it's the operational detail: Anthropic's stated involvement. This isn't about AI replacing human thought or drafting entire texts. It's about the unglamorous, high-leverage work of semantic consistency, historical cross-referencing, and tonal accuracy across a complex, high-stakes document. When you're building with LLMs for nuanced applications, this is the blueprint. It shows AI as an augmentation layer for domain experts, not a replacement. If you're building with AI and want to cut through the noise to what actually matters, check out the field guide. Link in bio.
